column3: “Deep of lip and heavy of tongue” is rendered “unintelligible speech or difficult language.”
“If not to them I had sent you” is rendered “But I have sent you to them who should listen”; the Hebrew is difficult.
“Hard of forehead and stubborn of heart” is rendered “stubborn and obstinate.”
“A spirit” is rendered “the Spirit”; “Blessed be the glory” follows the Hebrew, where a small change gives “as the glory rose.”
